verdict.rationale: cubic's GitHub app already runs headlessly by auto-reviewing PRs on each push (cubic-docs-4), and its CLI (`cubic review`) can be invoked locally or scripted before a push (cubic-docs-8), plus a documented Analytics API for pulling PR-level data programmatically (cubic-docs-20). However, there is no explicit documentation of a CI-specific mode, pipeline integration guide, or exit-code/CI-flag behavior for automated pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline setup docs (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI examples), documented non-interactive flags/exit codes for `cubic review`, and independent confirmation of headless CI usage.
